subject: How do I extract or output the expected information matrix from lavaan

messages.author: 12cfaf35d869d099
messages.subject: How do I extract or output the expected information matrix from lavaan
parts:
The 'likelihood = expected' option gives me the expected information matrix in the lavaan analysis.
How do I output this matrix.  I am assuming that the observed matrix would be the same procedure, etc..

messages.author: 89c9fc822e34b78c
messages.subject: Re: How do I extract or output the expected information matrix from lavaan
parts:
On 04/02/2014 08:38 PM, Darren Johnson wrote:
> The 'likelihood = expected' option gives me the expected information matrix in the lavaan analysis.
> How do I output this matrix. I am assuming that the observed matrix would be the same procedure, etc..

If 'fit' is the fitted lavaan object, you can get the information matrix
by typing

solve(vcov(fit)) / nobs(fit)

Yves.
